start.text: You look road-worn, stranger. The Rusty Ladle's still serving if you've got coin. What do you need?

about.text: Grey Valley. A hundred souls, one road in, one road out. We keep to ourselves and hope the Black Dog Gang keeps to itself too.

news.text: Farmer Holt's been losing livestock down south. Says it's thieves. If you're the helpful sort, he'd pay to know who.
